Enabling export adds existing readings for your chosen user, then new readings automatically. Guest readings and readings without a valid date and time are skipped. Monitor times use your phone’s timezone when first exported.

Only blood pressure, measurement time and device information are shared. Pulse, irregular heartbeat flags, notes and device data stay on your phone. OpenPressure does not read your Health Connect data.
Turning export off stops future exports. Deleting a local reading or uninstalling OpenPressure does not remove its Health Connect copy. Manage copies and permissions in Health Connect.

Privacy and Health Connect
OpenPressure stores your readings and saved monitor data on your phone. It has no account, servers, internet access or analytics. Android backups are disabled.

Health Connect export is optional and off by default. You choose your own monitor user number (1 or 2) and grant permission to write blood pressure. Readings for that user from every saved monitor are exported to your personal Health Connect record, including existing and future readings. Guest readings and readings without a valid date and time are skipped.

Only systolic and diastolic blood pressure, measurement times and device information are exported. Monitor times have no timezone, so your phone’s timezone at first export is used and saved. Pulse, irregular heartbeat flags, notes and raw device data are not exported. OpenPressure does not request permission to read health data and does not read Health Connect records.

OpenPressure sends no data off your phone. Health Connect stores exported copies on your device. Other apps may read or transfer those copies if you separately grant them access through Health Connect. Their own privacy policies apply.

You can turn off future exports in OpenPressure. Turning export off, deleting a local reading or uninstalling OpenPressure does not delete existing Health Connect copies. Use Health Connect to manage its records and revoke permissions. Uninstalling OpenPressure removes its local readings and saved monitor data. Export your local data first if you want to keep it.
